# mtncloud_storage_volumes (Data Source)

Lists your storage volumes, including those made in the console. Disks attached to your instances.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_storage_volumes" "all" {}

output "storage_volumes" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_storage_volumes.all.storage_volumes : x.id => { name = x.name, size = x.size } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud` (String) Only list storage volumes whose `cloud` is this (case ignored).
- `datastore` (String) Only list storage volumes whose `datastore` is this (case ignored).
- `name_regex` (String) Only return storage volumes whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.
- `status` (String) Only list storage volumes whose `status` is this (case ignored).
- `type` (String) Only list storage volumes whose `type` is this (case ignored).

### Read-Only

- `storage_volumes` (Attributes List) The storage volumes, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--storage_volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_volumes`

Read-Only:

- `cloud` (String) Cloud it is in.
- `datastore` (String) Datastore it is on.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `device_name` (String) Device name, for example `/dev/vdb`.
- `id` (Number) ID of the storage volume.
- `name` (String) Name of the storage volume.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether it is read-only.
- `root_volume` (Boolean) Whether it is an instance's root disk.
- `size` (Number) Size in bytes.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `type` (String) Volume type.
